scope: System 1 corpus construction and investigation handoff; System 2 remains a non-promoting shadow review.

evidence.primary_result: The preregistered chronological validation improvement did not persist on the frozen later-time holdout: linear MAE 1.4767 versus raw-sensor MAE 1.4101.
evidence.reserve_result: The independently specified fixed-effect reconstruction had held-block MAE from 1.1287 to 1.8602; stable transfer was not established.

verdict: System 1 produced an investigation-ready, evidence-traceable corpus pair and a reproducible bounded method-learning result. Its gates correctly prevented a validation-only gain and an unavailable published runtime from becoming a final positive claim.

redesign_decision.required_before_next_batch: Keep runtime preflight and frozen independent reconstruction as seed-admission requirements; require an executable primary and reserve before final-outcome work.

limits: This does not establish System 1 as generally reliable across domains.
This does not certify either reconstruction as equivalent to its published workflow.
This does not promote a System-2 cross-domain target or verdict.
All rejected candidates and runtime failures remain part of the corpus.
next_permitted_action: Run a new bounded, contrasting seed batch only after the redesigned runtime-preflight contract is applied; evaluate construction and handoff quality independently.
